description: AMP - Venta de combustible marino a través de barcazas, según litoral en Toneladas Métricas agosto 2026 is a dataset listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Maritima de Panamá. Presenta el movimiento de la venta de combustible marino a través de barcazas, según litoral Atlántico y Pacífico en toneladas métricas, movimiento de naves, movimiento de barcazas. Coverage: Panamá. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad Maritima de Panamá. Its tags are Barcazas, Combustible Marino, Puerto, ventas. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
